system_prompt_style.note: Paper only; no prompt construction mechanism described.

env_context_strategy.note: The paper parses the PDF into an asset library via MinerU/Docling. This is paper-to-page, not repo context; no config surface is available.

observation_format.note: Paper only; the HTML checker inspects the rendered page, but the observation format is not stated.

edit_primitive.note: The HTML Generator renders full files, but no edit tool is described.

protocol_standardization.note: No code or dependency list is available.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: AutoPage deconstructs paper-to-page creation into a coarse-to-fine pipeline from narrative planning to multimodal content generation and interactive rendering.
loop_primitives.note: The three-phase pipeline runs with a checker after each phase. Sec. 5.5 mentions a 'verifier-driven, multi-turn refinement process'.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: The output of this stage is a foundational blueprint, which undergoes a verification step to en- sure its completeness and logical soundness before proceeding to content generation.
planning_granularity.note: The Page Content Planner produces a section outline (blueprint) that the later stages consume.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: AutoPage decomposes the complex task of webpage creation into a structured pipeline encompassing three core phases

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: This process is orchestrated by two collaborating agents that first deconstruct the paper’s content and then architect a new, web-centric narrative.
delegation_mechanism.note: Closest value: agents hand outputs to one another in a fixed sequence.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: It is worth noting that all the aforementioned human-in-the-loop interactions are optional, as the system can operate in a fully autonomous mode.
human_in_loop.note: Human checkpoints are optional: content refinement (Sec. 3.2), template selection, and final HTML feedback. The paper does not state which mode is the default; experiments ran fully automated.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: The re- sult is an asset library that neatly organizes the paper’s core components
short_term_state.note: The asset library and blueprint are structured intermediates.

long_term_memory.note: A template library exists, but this is not memory; no memory surface is available.

self_verification.evidence_quote: dedicated LLM/VLM- based "checkers" act like quality inspectors on an assembly line, validating the generated content against the source paper before it proceeds to the next stage.

retry_policy.note: Checker-driven refinement is described, but no retry count is given.

cost_controls.note: The paper reports cost under $0.1 per page but describes no control mechanism.

eval_hooks.note: The paper describes the PageBench benchmark and says tools will be released; no repo is available to check.

target_domain.evidence_quote: We introduce the novel task of automated webpage generation for an academic paper.
target_domain.note: The task is paper-to-webpage generation (scientific communication).

open_source.evidence_quote: Code and dataset will be released at Webpage1.
open_source.note: A release was promised, but no repo appears in the evidence.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: AutoPage exhibits model-agnostic adaptability, functioning with vari- ous end-to-end models (e.g., GPT-4o, Gemini, and Qwen) without any adjustments to prompts or con- figurations.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: Code and dataset will be released at Webpage1.

first_release_date.note: The evidence shows only arXiv:2510.19600v2 dated 30 Jun 2026; the v1 date is not given.

pinned_version.note: No repo is available; the paper version is pinned instead.
